worldcombat.skill.faketears.summary: Feign tears in front of a foe to make it soften and drop its Sp. Def, and the moment the trick lands the target freezes for an instant. The tears must be seen, so the range is short and line of sight matters; the more cherished the caster, the more convincing the act.
worldcombat.skill.faketears.use.0: Strip the Sp. Def of a special attacker up close
worldcombat.skill.faketears.use.1: Buy an instant of hesitation when something is on top of you
worldcombat.skill.faketears.use.2: Win the first exchange for a teammate
On a hit the target loses %1$s stages of Sp. Def, and that drop does not recover when the fluster ends - it lasts until combat breaks or its stages are reset. The target is also left flustered for about %2$s.
The feint only carries within %1$s blocks and needs a clear line of sight; on a hit the target is pinned and cannot move for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.faketears.timing: Range %1$s blocks, telegraph %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.faketears.preference.a: Only consider the feint when a threat is within this distance; smaller keeps it to grappling range, larger chases targets down.
Targeting: only feign when the target is attacking you or your owner, or when you were just hurt. Anytime: feign as soon as a target is in range.
On: the companion will leave a hold position to deliver the feint.
